content: If the dataTypePolicy of the respective ISignal is set to net- workRepresentationFromComSpec and the networkRepresentation of the re- spective ReceiverComSpec is defined, the RTE of the receiving ECU shall perform the conversion of the data element that is received over a communication bus from the representation specified by the baseType and compuMethod of the networkRep- resentation of the respective ReceiverComSpec . In this case [SWS_Rte_03816] shall not be applied.
